messages:
Asha (PM): planning sync. Acme wants a lightweight private pilot. We need to agree MVP scope + dependency owners so we aren't blocked next sprint. low ceremony but production-grade.
Omar (Dir Prod): high-level tradeoff: prioritize isolation + key controls over feature completeness. customer's must-haves: tenant isolation, CMK (maybe temporary exception), deterministic perf. nice-to-have: autoscale, advanced routing.
Ken (Runtime): runtime constraints: model = 13B (confirmed). to meet p95 <1s we likely need quantization + warm cache for prefix-heavy flows. quantization may alter output slightly.
Asha (PM): can we quantify that delta? need guardrails for regressions.
Ken (Runtime): we'll run A/B on eval set and flag any BLEU/ROUGE-ish drops + hallucination rate. fallback path: auto-fallback to FP16 variant if regression > threshold.
Zoe (Eng PM): infra/security dependencies affect timeline. what do we absolutely need from infra/security to start runtime work?
Priya (Infra): must-haves: VPC peering, route tables, reserved subnet for GPUs, and signed vendor PO to reserve GPUs. lead time: 7 business days for network + 5 for vendor procurement if PO today.
Marco (Security): must-haves: KMS integration (CMK preferred). if customer allows Redwood-managed keys for pilot we can shave ~3 days. SIEM ingest and audit retention policy also required for SOC2 evidence.
Noah (SRE): monitoring + alerting scope: track p95/p99 latency, error rate, memory pressure on GPU nodes, and KV cache hit ratio. need dashboards + an automated rollback script that can flip routing to hosted fallback.
Asha (PM): propose MVP cut: (1) tenant isolation + encryption, (2) p95 <1s with 5% canary, (3) rollback path to hosted, (4) SOC2 evidence pack. defer autoscale, prefetch optimizer, advanced routing. agree?
Omar (Dir Prod): agree. document this as "Slim MVP" and get signoff from Acme on acceptance criteria.
Ken (Runtime): actionables for runtime:
- quant profile + perf delta on eval set -> 48h
- fallback FP16 build + switcher -> 72h
- prewarm script for canary lanes -> 72h
Priya (Infra): infra actionables:
- network diagram + PO req -> 24h
- reserved GPU slot request filed -> 48h (vendor ETA 5bd)
Marco (Security): security actionables:
- KMS options doc (CMK vs Redwood) + SIEM plan -> 48h
- audit evidence checklist for SOC2 -> 72h
Zoe (Eng PM): SRE/ops:
- dashboards stub + alert rules -> 24h
- rollback automation stub -> 48h
Asha (PM): owners: Priya owns deployment pipeline, Ken owns perf signoff, Marco owns security signoff, Asha owns customer signoff. Noah on-call during canary.
Noah (SRE): suggest adding a 24h observation gate after 5% canary before ramping. we should also run a short chaos test (kill a worker) to validate graceful fallback.
Asha (PM): agreed. include simple chaos checklist in runbook.
Priya (Infra): vendor note: if PO misses this sprint, provisioning slides into next sprint. can we accept hosted fallback for canary temporarily?
Omar (Dir Prod): product is OK with a documented hosted fallback as long as Acme signs it. Jenna (Solutions) -- oh wait Jenna is out today, Zoe can coordinate on approvals?
Zoe (Eng PM): I'll collect approvals and log them. Ops-bot: meeting scheduled: vendor-PO-check 1774335400.
Asha (PM): risks & mitigations:
- risk: quantization causes quality regression -> mitigation: AB test + auto-fallback + strict threshold (0.5% hallucination increase)
- risk: PO delay -> mitigation: documented hosted fallback + customer sign-off
- risk: KMS requirement (CMK) delays timeline -> mitigation: temporary Redwood-managed key with contractual rotation + migration plan
Asha (PM): timeline sketch if all ETAs met:
Day 0: finalize acceptance eval + customer sign off on fallback
Day 1: infra diagram + dashboards stub + KMS options
Day 2-3: quant perf + fallback build + PO submission
Day 4: provision reserved pool (vendor permitting) + canary deploy 5%
Day 5-6: canary observation + chaos check + signoff gate
Day 7: limited ramp / pilot handoff to customer
Marco (Security): one ask: include explicit data flow diagram in the acceptance pack showing where keys are used and which logs are exported.
Asha (PM): noted. I'll draft the one-pager and share with Acme. please drop ETA confirmations here by EOD.
Ken (Runtime): ETA confirmations posted.
Priya (Infra): ETA confirmations posted.
Marco (Security): ETA confirmations posted.
Zoe (Eng PM): I'll post the approval tracker when I have Acme's note.
Asha (PM): perfect. I'll convert this thread into the slim-MVP PRD and post link. thanks all. :rocket:
